classification: Product notice lifecycle defect exposed by the D22 read-only Source pointer diagnosis
cause: Capture correctly announces a no-workspace read failure before selection, but its notice has no typed resolution condition. NoticeHost keeps the bottom overlay mounted after the organization resolver reports a selected workspace, so the stale notice can intercept otherwise enabled controls.
sibling_census: The same stale Capture notice was documented as covering Settings Reset and Vault controls; those acceptance runners manually dismissed the exact alert after organization setup. Other database failures have different remedies and must remain visible.
repair: The shared Notice type carries a typed active-organization resolution condition. Only a no-workspace refusal from a subscribed read that explicitly retries on organization selection receives that condition; the Capture queue opts in. Failed inserts, updates and deletes do not opt in and remain visible because selecting an organization does not replay the action. NoticeHost retires matching read notices on selection or late arrival; unrelated errors are untouched.
verification: The original Capture read guard passed and native read-only source-workspace-007 observed its notice retiring after selection. Independent operation census found the write-notice gap and root's guarded notice-write-retention-red-001 run failed the two intended write assertions while both read cases passed. The narrower correction awaits guarded green, typecheck and independent review; this report does not close D23.
d22_boundary: The original Source Save click remains ambiguous. The private one-attempt checkpoint is unchanged; this repair neither dispatches Save nor authorizes retry.
